detail.longDescription:
Rakazo is an open source alternative to closed AI bot apps: persistent AI teammates that do real work, on a server you control.

Create specialized bots, give each one a clear role, and keep every conversation in one focused thread. Your bots can use a sandboxed computer and browser, remember context, run routines, and notify you when work is complete.

With the Rakazo app you can:

• See all of your bots and recent activity in one place.
• Create bots with their own role and instructions.
• Send messages and follow work as it happens.
• Open a bot's remote computer and take control when needed.
• Receive notifications when a task finishes.
• Connect to an Inbox Zero-hosted or self-hosted Rakazo server.

Rakazo is built for people who want capable AI agents without giving up control of their infrastructure, model provider, or data.

An account on a compatible Rakazo server is required.
